setup_bootstrap.first_set_up_the_databas: Okokuqala, lungisa idatabase. Ngemva kwalokho uzokhetha ukuthi uqale umhlaba omusha noma ujoyine i-mesh esikhona — futhi, uma uqala kabusha, dala i-akhawunti yakho yophathi.
setup_joinhost.already_connected_to_a_ho: Usuxhumene nohost — lokhu kuqhubeka nokuvumelanisa lapho kwashiyeka khona (aludingeki i-URL yohost).
setup_joinhost.checks_the_public_front_d: Ihlola isango lomphakathi, futhi — uma uvuma — ikensiza inethiwekhi yakho yasendaweni. Alidingeki ikheli.
setup_joinhost.connect_this_node_to_a_fe: Xhuma le nodi kumfelandawonye osebenza kakade. Kuvumelanisa yonke imidlalo — isisekelo semaphu, umthethosisekelo, nezikhungo — futhi iba ikhophi yesibuko efundwa kuphela. Akukho ukwakha izikhungo: udlala imidlalo efanayo nalabo bonke abakwi-mesh.
setup_joinhost.connected_pulling_the_cor: Kuxhumekile — kuthathwa imininingwane ngemuva. Inqubo ephilayo ibonakala ngezansi; lokhu kuphela ngokwakho (futhi kuqhubeka uma kuphazamiseka). Ungashiya le khasi.
setup_joinhost.host_adoption_console_pen: Ikonsoli yokwamukela uhost → Izicelo zokwamukelwa ezilindile
setup_joinhost.join_key_optional_leave_b: Ikeyi yokujoyina (iyakhethwa — shiya isingelutho ukuze ucele ukuvunyelwa kophathi wohost)
setup_joinhost.no_federations_found_ente: Akukho mifelandawonye etholakele. Faka i-URL yohost ngesandla ngezansi, noma hlola ibanga lenethiwekhi yakho uzame futhi.
setup_joinhost.request_sent_the_host_ope: Isicelo sithunyelwe — uphathi wohost kumele asivumele.
setup_modefork.build_the_game_here_autho: Yakha umdlalo lapha — bhala umthethosisekelo, faka imaphu, dweba izifunda, hlala ezikhungweni. Uba ngumdlalo osemthethweni, futhi amanye ama-nodi ayazihlanganisa nawe. Kunconywa kwenodi yokuqala kumfelandawonye.
setup_modefork.connect_to_a_host_already: Xhuma nohost osevele asemfelandawonyeni. Konke kuvumelaniswa — isisekelo semaphu, umthethosisekelo, nazo zonke izikhungo — futhi le nodi iba ikhophi yesibuko efundwa kuphela. Akukho ukwakha izikhungo; udlala imidlalo efanayo nalabo bonke abakwi-mesh.
setup_modefork.how_should_this_node_join: Le nodi kufanele ijoyine kanjani umdlalo?
setup_modefork.this_choice_is_one_way_fo: Lokhu kukhetha kwenziwa kanye kuphela empilweni ye-instance. Ukudala kabusha kudinga i-docker compose down -v.
setup_modefork.your_operator_account_is_: I-akhawunti yakho yophathi isilungiswe. Yonke inodi ku-mesh idlala imidlalo efanayo — ngakho umbuzo owodwa ukuthi le nodi iqala umhlaba noma ijoyina lowo osekhona.
setup_operatorsetup.create_the_account_t: Dala i-akhawunti eqhuba le nodi, nikeza ibhokisi ikheli, bese uvula izindima zakho zophathi. Uyena uphathi omsulwa, ngakho zonke izindima zingezakho ukuzivula ngqo.
setup_operatorsetup.hand_a_colleague_a_o: Nikeza osebenza nawe isikripithi sokuqala senye ifayili. Solo = bathole umhlala wabo; Join = bakhopha le (kudingeka ikheli lenodi yakho elibekwe ngenhla).
setup_operatorsetup.infrastructure_confi: Ukulungiswa kwengqalasizinda kuza ngokulandelayo — ungavula indima manje bese uqedela ukulungiswa kwayo lapho.
setup_operatorsetup.just_me_for_now_runs: Mina kuphela, okwamanje. Isebenza kule khompyutha. Akudingeki ikheli — ungakuvule kwabanye kamuva lapho usulungele ukwamukela abalingani.
setup_operatorsetup.localhost_only_works: — i-localhost isebenza kule khompyutha kuphela; sebenzisa ikheli lakho le-LAN/lomphakathi kubalingani bangempela.
setup_operatorsetup.prefer_the_full_cons: Ukhetha ikonsoli ephelele? Vula ikonsoli yophathi →
setup_operatorsetup.roles_become_availab: Imisebenzi iba khona lapho i-akhawunti yophathi engenhla isetshelwe.
setup_operatorsetup.running_a_node_carri: Ukuqhuba i-node kunikeza imisebenzi yophathi ku-mesh — imisebenzi yengqalasizinda, hhayi imalume yomuzi (ayithengi ukuvota noma isihlalo). Njengophathi oqala, uzizibeka ngqo lapha; lapho uhulumeni esala esihlalweni, imisebenzi ebuswayo ibuyela ekuvumananeni kwabo ukuze kushintshwe kamuva.
setup_operatorsetup.set_a_reachable_node: Setha ikheli lenode elingafinyeleleka phezulu kuqala, ngoba isikripithi sokuhlanganisa ngeke yazi ukuthi ifonele kuphi.
setup_operatorsetup.set_the_address_peer: Setha ikheli abalingani abalifona ukuze bafinyelele kule bhokisi.
setup_operatorsetup.some_roles_still_nee: Ezinye izindima zisadinga ukusethwa ngaphambi kokuba zisebenze:
setup_operatorsetup.the_address_changed_: Ikheli lishintshile. Phinda usebenzise umyalo woqalo (docker compose up -d) ukuze ama-container alithole ngaphambi kokuba abalingani bahlangane.
setup_operatorsetup.who_should_be_able_t: Ubani okufanele akwazi ukufinyelela kule node?
setup_operatorsetup.your_physical_operat: Izimfuno zakho zophathi wokuqondile — i-akhawunti eqhuba futhi ibuse le node.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.a_friendly_lab: Ilabeli elilula lalokhu kufakwa — libonakala e-nav nasemidondolweni yomfelandawonye.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.compressed_sim: Isimulasyon esicindezelwe — khetha imizuzwana ngonyaka wesimulasyon.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.elections_on_w: Ukukhetho ngesikhathi sangempela — umjikelezo wezinyaka ezi-5 ngokujwayelekile.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.let_s_set_your: Masithele ikheli lakho lezinkanyezi — isisekelo i-instance yakho ezohlanganisa ngaphansi kwalo.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.this_is_the_co: Lolu wuhlelo lwe-Cosmopolitan Governance App — inkundla evulekile yomfelandawonye esebenzisa uMthethosisekelo Onguquki. Lwakha zonke izikhungo ezichazwe yi-Template (ukuhlala, ukukhetho, isishayamthetho, isigungu esiphethe, ubulungiswa, inhlangano) njengohlelo lwe-software olusebenzisekayo noluzenzakalelayo, kusukela ezingeni lomuzi kuya ezingeni lomhlaba nangaphezulu.
setup_step1_constants.a_world_wide_setti: Isilungiselelo somhlaba wonke. Khetha ukuthi lo mhlaba uphatha kanjani umthethosisekelo wawo. Kugcinwa ngokushesha lapho ukhetha.

setup_step1_constants.set_once_inherited: Sethwa kanye, kufundwa yonke indawo. Konke okujwayelekile komthethosisekelo nomnotho lapha kuqala izilungiselelo zendawo yegunya ngayinye ezingashintshwa futhi kudlulele ezindaweni zegunya ezintsha lapho ziqala ukusebenza — ukuze zingaphinde ziqale kabusha. setup_step1_constants.the_starting_econo: Umnotho oqala owomhlaba wakho — lokhu kudlulela ezindaweni zegunya ezincane njengokwenziwa kwemithethosisekelo.
setup_step1_constants.total_legislature_: Ubukhulu besishayamthetho buyabalwa ngokusekelwe kubantu, bese bufakwa phakathi kwe [min, max], bese bahlukaniswa ezifundeni zobukhulu be [min_seats, max_seats].
setup_step1_constants.you_are_founding_t: Usungula umthethosisekelo nomnotho wawo manje — amanani angaphansi ayiziphakamiso ze-Fair Constitution Template (okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile), abonisa njengokubhekwa. Ungaphuma kuwo lapha. Emva kokusungulwa, noma yikuphi ukushintsha okwengeziwe kumele kudlule ngezinqumo zesishayamthetho ezisemthethweni.
setup_step2_mapdata.basemap_tiles_protom: Ama-tiles emboniso-base — Protomaps maps.protomaps.com · i-vector planet basemap yengemuva lemaphu
setup_step2_mapdata.fetch_the_open_datas: Thola idatha evulekile ngqo emabhokisini abo asemthethweni, bese uyayifaka. Ububanzi bezwe buyakhethwa — shiya kuvulekile (ezinkethweni zokuqala ngezansi) ukuze ulande zonke izwe.
setup_step2_mapdata.heads_up_the_protoma: Qaphela: ukwakhiwa kwe-Protomaps planet kunemigqomo engu-100 GB futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukulanda. Yilande kuphela uma ufuna imboniso-base yomhlaba wonke.
setup_step2_mapdata.if_your_map_files_li: Uma amafayela emaphu akho ekunye kule khompyutha, faka lelo fola lapha. Kubhalwe ku-ARCHIVE_PATH ku-.env yakho ukuze i-container iphinde ifake /archive kuyo. Ku-Windows, sebenzisa indlela yakho ye-host (isib. D:\fair-constitution-map-files).
setup_step2_mapdata.ingest_a_specific_co: Faka indlela ethile ye-container — isithombe esihlukile noma isigaba esingaphansi kwe-/archive. (Ukuze ukhombe efoleni ehlukile kukhompyutha yakho, sebenzisa "Khombisa ifola yasendaweni" phezulu.)
setup_step2_mapdata.ingest_whatever_is_d: Faka noma yini etholakele phezulu endleleni ye-container {sources} (emayelana nefola lakho le-ARCHIVE_PATH). Indlela esheshayo — ayikho inethiwekhi.
setup_step2_mapdata.load_at_least_one_na: Landa okukulungele isizwe esisodwa (ADM1) ngaphambi kokuqhubeka
setup_step2_mapdata.no_country_scope_set: Akukho bubanzi bezwe abekwe — lokhu kulanda WONKE amazwe (umhlaba wonke). Lindela 14 GB+ yemingcele + idatha yomphakathi namahora okulanda. Ukuze ukunqande, faka uhlu lwe-ISO3 eZinkethweni Zokuqala ngezansi (isib. NZL,USA).
setup_step2_mapdata.open_data_flag_revie: ⚑ {open} isifanekiso sedatha evulekile{flagState} — buyekeza futhi ulungise ku-Jurisdiction Viewer → {critical} okubalulekile {warning} isixwayiso {info} imininingwane
setup_step2_mapdata.pause_on_first_excep: Misa ekuhlanganeni kokuqala okungaphumelelanga. Uma kunoma yiziphi iziphutha zezwe, misa ukuqala ukuze ukwazi ukushiya lelo zwe, uzame futhi, noma uyise. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, irekhodi libhala iphutha bese liyaqhubeka.
setup_step2_mapdata.point_at_your_map_da: Khombisa idatha yemaphu yakho, bese uqala i-ETL pipeline. Inqubekela phambili ibonakala buqobo kusuka ku-ETL container. Uma ukuqala kuqedile, buyekeza noma yiziphi izinto ezingafani ngaphambi kokuqhubeka nokuhlukanisa izifunda.
setup_step2_mapdata.population_worldpop_: Umphakathi — idatha ye-WorldPop data.worldpop.org (CC BY 4.0) · idonsa nemingcele (kudingeka ukuze kuhlonishwe umphakathi)
setup_step2_mapdata.running_cube_root_ap: Kusetshenziswa ukwabelana kwe-cube-root kuhlelo lwendawo yegunya…
setup_step2_mapdata.the_archive_mount_is: Ukuxhumana kwe-archive {archive_mount} akukho ku-ETL container. Setha ifolda yakho yangaphakathi ngezansi (bese uqala kabusha), noma landa idatha emithonjeni esemthethweni.
setup_step2_mapdata.the_import_finished_: Ukungenisa kuphelile. Vula i-jurisdiction viewer ukuze uhlole imingcele, abahlali, ama-raster overlays, ubudlelwane be-dual-footprint, nokungaguquki okufakwe isiboniso — bese yamukela idatha yemephu lapho (planet scope). Chofoza u-Continue ngezansi lapho usuyamukele — lokhu kuqala ukwabelana.
setup_step2_mapdata.upload_a_tarball_or_: Landela i-tarball noma ifolda kusukela kule browser. I-Multipart upload handler ayikabi isebenza.
setup_step2_mapdata.you_pointed_the_app_: Uqondise i-app ku-{sources}, kodwa ama-containers akakayitholi. Shesha lokhu efoldeni ye-app (yakha kabusha ama-containers — ukumisa/ukuqala noma ukuqala kabusha akwanele), bese uchofoza u-Re-check:
setup_step3_districts.a_banner_at_the_to: I-banner phezulu kwe-mapper izokukhumbuza ukuthi usemodeshi yokusetha.
setup_step3_districts.accepting_the_map_: Ukukwamukela idatha yemephu kuqale ukwakha okugcwele: yonke indawo yegunya ithola isishayamthetho esikhulu ngokomthetho we-cube-root, futhi isishayamthetho ngasinye sithola imephu yesifunda yokuqala — ama-mixed-autoseed sweeps ezindawo zezegunya ezinabavoti, ama-single at-large councils emagoba. Ungahamba; ukusebenza kuzilungisa ngokwakho kunoma yikuphi ukuhlukumezeka phakathi kwemizuzu futhi le phage iyikulandelela.
setup_step3_districts.completed_maps_sea: Imephu ezi-{run} eziphelele zinama-seat ahlukile kwama-seat abelwe kwesishayamthetho sazo (net {run2}{run3}). Lokhu kuwumphephu. Isihlalo esiphambili sabelela kubantwana, ngakho ama-seat emephu kumele ahlangane ne-total ebelwe. Le mephu zidinga ukudwetshwa kabusha.
setup_step3_districts.cube_root_sizing_a: Ukubala kwe-Cube-root kusebenza ngokomthetho kaTaagepera — yonke indawo yegunya, kuya phansi.
setup_step3_districts.geometry_precomput: Geometry precompute (imingcele yomakhelwane, ikhokhwa kanye){shown} / {precompute} · {failed} ibuyela live
setup_step3_districts.halt_the_full_scal: Mise ukusebenza okugcwele? Abasebenzi bayama emingceleni yabo elandelayo; konke okusebenziwe kuhlala. Ungaqhubeka noma nini.
setup_step3_districts.review_items_above: Izinto ezibuyekezwayo phezulu zixhumana ngqo ne-mapper yesishayamthetho esithintekile.
setup_step3_districts.spot_check_any_leg: Hlola noma isiphi isishayamthetho ku-mapper yesifunda esisebenzayo — imephu ka {root_jurisdiction} iyona eqala ukubukwa. Ukufunda kuhlezi kuphephile phakathi nohambo; isishayamthetho esisahlanjwa manje sinezilawuli zazo zokutshala okuzenzakalayo ezikhiyiwe kuze kube yilapho ukuhlanjwa kuqeda.
setup_step3_districts.step_1_must_finish: Isinyathelo 1 kufanele kuqede ukulanda okukungeke kwenzeke okukulungele i-ADM0 ngaphambi kokuba izifunda zikhunjwe. Buyela esinyathelweni sedatha yemephu ukuze uqinisekise.
setup_step3_districts.you_can_always_com: Ungabuyela lapha noma nini ngokuvakashela i-/setup.
setup_step4_confirm.existing_institution: Imigqa yezikhungo ezikhona itholwe ({existing_executives} isigungu esiphethe, {existing_judiciaries} ubulungiswa) — izohlala njengoba zinjalo.
setup_step4_confirm.for_every_jurisdicti: Kuyo yonke indawo yegunya enesishayamthetho sizofaka umugqa owodwa wesigungu esiphethe (uhlobo olujwayelekile: ikomiti) nomugqa owodwa wobulungiswa (uhlobo olujwayelekile: okukhethiwe, amajaji angama-5 okuncane, izikhathi zeminyaka eyi-10).
setup_step4_confirm.no_members_or_seats_: Akukho malungu noma izihlalo ezizuzwayo — lezo ziza nge-engine yokukhetho. Isimo sihlala kukwakhiwa kuze kube isigaba sesi-2.
setup_step4_confirm.one_per_jurisdiction: Kanye ngendawo yegunya enezingane eziqondile, isayizi isuselwa emithethweni ye-cube-root.
setup_step4_confirm.per_the_maps_you_bui: Ngokwezimephu ozakhe noma ozihlanganise ngokuzenzakalela esinyathelweni sesi-3.
setup_step4_confirm.review_the_shape_of_: Buyekeza isimo se-instance yakho, bese uhlala isigungu esiphethe nezikhungo zobulungiswa kuyo yonke indawo yegunya enesishayamthetho. Ziqala ukwakheka — amalungu angempela akhethwa lapho i-engine yokukhetho ithunyelwa esigabeni sesi-2 somgomo omkhulu.
setup_step4_confirm.we_ll_record_setup_c: Sizorekhoda i-setup_completed_at kuzilungiselelo ze-instance. Kusukela lapha /setup ikuqondisa ekhasini lokuqala.
setup_step4_confirm.your_instance_is_set: I-instance yakho isilungiswe. Izishayamthetho zinokusayizi, izifunda zikhunjwe, kanti isigungu esiphethe + izikhungo zobulungiswa zakhiwe futhi zilindele ukukhethwa kwazo kokuqala. Wamukelekile kumthethosisekelo wakho owonke.
